request.description: Edit these TWO EXISTING frames of the same Ataho v2 tiger; do not redesign or upscale the character. Keep the native 96x96 canvas, roughly60px full-body height, original LARGE head size, muzzle/ears/face stripes, small closed tiger paw, short thick arm, original jacket folds and small shaded pixel clusters. Retain the original palette and single-pixel detail, bare paws, dark loose pants, brown cropped jacket and striped tail. Keep identical character proportions between the two edited frames. Pose edits only, feet baseline y80, full sprite and tail inside canvas. BOTH target screen RIGHT / SOUTH-EAST. FRAME1 (first image, chamber A): lower pelvis and bend BOTH knees into a moderately wider staggered stance, both soles planted. Fold torso slightly toward target. Pull right fist back LOW beside waist, elbow back, left fist in front; compact coiled body. FRAME2 (second image, impact B): extend existing right punch horizontally at shoulder height, below eyes. Rotate hips and shoulders away enough to expose jacket BACK, head still looking RIGHT. Keep head as large as source, never shrink it to expose more back. Low pelvis, both knees bent and feet widely planted. Left counterfist LOW beside rear hip, not raised behind ribs. Same compact body volume as FRAME1, not a broad human torso. Body rotation drives the strike, no tall upright karate pose. Preserve the original tiger hand design; no long human forearm or oversized fist. Empty transparent background, no effects, text or ground. Return TWO edited frames in their original order, not a comparison layout.
